accepted_edge_types.name: USES_OUTPUT_OF_PRIOR_ACTION
accepted_edge_types.definition: A subsequent agent action consumes, as an input argument or dependency, an artifact or output that was generated by an earlier agent action.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An earlier agent action that generated an artifact, file, or value.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent agent action that references or consumes that generated artifact as input.

accepted_edge_types.name: VERIFIES_OUTPUT_OF_PRIOR_ACTION
accepted_edge_types.definition: A subsequent agent action is executed in order to test or validate the correctness of an artifact produced by an earlier agent action.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An earlier agent action that produced an artifact whose correctness must be validated.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent agent action intended to verify or validate the correctness of that artifact.

accepted_edge_types.name: CORROBORATES_PRIOR_OBSERVATION
accepted_edge_types.definition: A later execution observation reports a condition that is consistent with and confirms a condition already reported by an earlier observation.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An earlier observation reporting a missing resource or environmental condition.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: A later observation reporting a consistent condition or consequent failure that confirms the earlier observation.
